title: eriogonum heermannii subsp. argense
intro: Eriogonum heermannii subsp. argense, commonly known as Desert Wild Buckwheat, is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family Polygonaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in Native American and Mexican folk medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Desert Wild Buckwheat include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, and it may also help to lower blood sugar levels and cholesterol. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcer properties.
